pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.text:
Our Privacy Policy
Introduction

We respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how it is used and protected.

Information We Collect
Personal Details: Name, phone number, email address, and delivery address provided during order placement.
Payment Information: UPI IDs or payment references used for transactions (not stored by us directly).
Usage Data: Device type, browser, and interactions on our platform to improve services.
How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

Process and deliver your food orders.
Communicate important updates regarding your order or account.
Maintain security and prevent fraud.
Enhance user experience and platform functionality.
Data Protection

We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Payment transactions are encrypted, and sensitive financial data is not stored on our servers.

Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell or trade personal data. Limited sharing may occur with trusted partners such as payment gateways or delivery staff, solely to complete your order.

Your Rights

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information by contacting our support team.

© 2025 Den-qr. All rights reserved.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions
pages.text:
Terms & Conditions
Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using our platform, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, you must discontinue use of our services.

Service Description

We provide an online food ordering and management platform that connects restaurants and customers. We facilitate the order and payment process but are not directly responsible for food preparation or delivery delays caused by restaurants.

User Responsibilities
You must provide accurate and complete information when placing orders.
You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and activity under your account.
Orders once placed cannot be altered beyond the restaurant’s policy.
Payment Terms

All payments are to be made through the supported payment methods (cash, UPI, or other available options). Orders are confirmed only after successful payment or confirmation of cash payment.

Restaurant Obligations

Restaurants are responsible for ensuring food quality, hygiene, timely preparation, and accurate menu details. We provide a platform but do not guarantee food quality or delivery timelines.

Prohibited Activities
Using the platform for fraudulent or illegal transactions.
Reverse-engineering, modifying, or misusing the software.
Spamming, abusive language, or harassment of staff or other users.
Limitation of Liability

We are not liable for indirect damages, including food quality issues, delays, or incorrect orders. Our liability is limited to the value of the order placed through the platform.

Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of updated terms.

pages.title: Refund Policy | Food Ordering Platform
pages.text:
Refund Policy

At Den-qr, customer satisfaction is our top priority. This Refund Policy outlines the conditions under which refunds may be issued for orders and subscription services.

1. Food Orders
Once an order has been placed and confirmed, it cannot be cancelled.
Refunds will only be considered in cases of:
Wrong items delivered.
Incomplete or missing items.
Non-delivery due to technical errors in the system.
All refund requests must be raised within 24 hours of the order time.
2. Subscription Plans
Subscription fees (Basic, Medium, Unlimited) are non-refundable once paid.
If technical issues prevent you from using your subscribed benefits, our support team will assist in resolving the issue.
Prorated refunds are not provided if you discontinue the service mid-term.
3. Payment Method

Refunds, if approved, will be processed through the same payment method (UPI, PhonePe, Google Pay, etc.) used at the time of purchase. Processing time may vary depending on the bank/payment provider.

4. Contact for Refund Requests

To request a refund, please contact our support team at:

Email: support@den-qr.com
Phone: +91-7999178184

© 2025 Den-qr. All rights reserved.

pages.text:

Shipping & Delivery Policy

Last updated on Oct 3rd 2025

International and Domestic Shipments

For **International buyers**, orders are shipped and delivered through registered international courier companies and/or International speed post only.

For **domestic buyers**, orders are shipped through registered domestic courier companies and/or speed post only.

Order Processing and Delivery

Orders are shipped within **Not Applicable** or as per the delivery date agreed at the time of order confirmation and delivery of the shipment subject to Courier Company/post office norms.

**Our Team is not liable for any delay in delivery by the courier company/postal authorities** and only guarantees to hand over the consignment to the courier company or postal authorities within **Not Applicable** from the date of the order and payment or as per the delivery date agreed at the time of order confirmation.

Delivery of all orders will be to the address provided by the buyer. Delivery of our **services** will be confirmed on your mail ID as specified during registration.

Contact Information

For any issues in utilizing our services, you may contact our helpdesk on:
Phone: 7999178184
Email: dengrorg.in@gmail.com
